digest.component_or_area: DC harness + inbound/outbound reconciler + rich-text cutover
propositions: Live DC harness must render rich-text bodies (Markdown→wiki markup: # heading, **bold**, {code} macro) and assert rendered HTML via Jira's ?expand=renderedFields endpoint produces expected tags (<h1>, <b>, <pre>) rather than verbatim source.

State-based echo-safety must hold end-to-end: a pushed rich body that lands on Jira and echoes back (rendered wiki) must decode to an unchanged value such that a second reconcile pass computes zero inbound/outbound mutations and re-pushes nothing.

Settled conflict behavior under the both-sides precondition (local edit + Jira edit to the same field before next pass) must keep local body, record remote value (not clobber), and emit a deduped outbound-field-conflict bridge alert.

Inbound differ must normalize Jira's echoed wiki form via the same codec (OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote) used by outbound echo-suppression, so the description's landed wire form is recognized as unchanged when re-read.

normalize_rich_text signature and behavior (None→'', str identity, non-dict→str(), ADF dict→markdown) must be pinned by contract test so breaking changes to the public seam fail before agentic-dev-platform's import breaks.
